reason: Sessions resumed after a break found the throwaway test Postgres stopped, and spent several tool calls, including a classifier-denied command, before it was back. A reusable recipe for checking, restarting and seeding the local test database belongs in one skill that every database-backed proof reuses.
The working `athena done` run set both database variables on the command line itself. The skill mentions only TEST_DATABASE_URL, so the next session may miss DATABASE_URL.
